content:
oliver: heads-up: the Go generator quickstart blocks for me when I cancel before the handshake finishes. reproducible with go 1.20 + go-sdk v0.14.1.

maya: can you paste the minimal snippet?

oliver: super small:
```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
gen := client.Generator("gpt-open")
go func(){ time.Sleep(150*time.Millisecond); cancel() }()
for gen.Next(ctx) { fmt.Println(gen.Value().Text) }
// gen.Close() sits here until ctx deadline
gen.Close()
```

felix: i saw similar in e2e: if auth retry/backoff happens during handshake it uses a background ctx and ignores the iterator ctx cancel. Close waits on that handshake and sits.

maya: rough workaround: call cancel(), then spawn Close() with a bounded ctx (goroutine + timeout). gross but unblocks CI.

doc-bot: created DE-2460: "go: generator handshake ignores iterator cancellation; Close waits forever" https://tracker/internal/DE-2460

felix: proposal: expose option to provide the handshake ctx (WithHandshakeCtx(ctx)) and add CloseWithContext(ctx) so callers can bound shutdown. i'll draft a small change and tests faking token refresh backoff.

maya: also update the quickstart sample to show both iterator and callback patterns and explicitly demonstrate the cancel-before-close pattern. newcomers hit this during onboarding.

oliver: thanks. i've added a tiny failing test gist: https://gist.github.com/oliver/gen-cancel-repro. marking issue high-onboarding.
